shortDescription: Modify environment variables on windows hosts

options.name: level
options.description: The level at which to set the environment variable. Use C(machine) to set for all users. Use C(user) to set for the current user that ansible is connected as. Use C(process) to set for the current process.  Probably not that useful.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the environment variable. Required when I(state=absent).

options.name: state
options.description: Set to C(present) to ensure environment variable is set. Set to C(absent) to ensure it is removed. When using I(variables), do not set this option.

options.name: value
options.description: The value to store in the environment variable. Must be set when I(state=present) and cannot be an empty string. Should be omitted for I(state=absent) and I(variables).

options.name: variables
options.description: A dictionary where multiple environment variables can be defined at once. Not valid when I(state) is set. Variables with a value will be set (C(present)) and variables with an empty value will be unset (C(absent)). I(level) applies to all vars defined this way.
